boundaries: A documented rule does not execute itself or grant authority.
A research hypothesis about question quality is not an enforced rule until an owner selects a check and response.
claim_ceiling: Generated project-scoped candidate Definition record only. Shape and projection checks grant no Lab admission, semantic truth, implementation, collection or employment-use authority.

scope.applicability: One case-bank process and declared version.
exclusions: Any other product or Lab-wide meaning without separate owner review and admission.

domain_context.explanation: Candidate Question Lifecycle Rule meaning for the Engineer Assessment product and research program. Its construct, implementation and use claims remain bounded by the source statement.

plain_language.explanation: It says what must hold when a question moves through the bank and what happens when it does not.

boundary_conditions: A documented rule does not execute itself or grant authority.

scientific_formal.normative_statement: A Question Lifecycle Rule is a versioned, scoped constraint on case development, review, release, assignment or retirement with an identified owner, check, failure handling and affected records.
